meta.name: Exact · polynomial-space query · compact basis
meta.metric: Parameterized query time in n and compactness c
meta.instance: Worst case; c-compact basis supplied as advice
meta.regime: Exact Euclidean CVPP with polynomial-space query computation and an explicitly bounded compactness c
meta.rules: A supplied basis is c-compact if every Voronoi-relevant vector has basis coordinates bounded in absolute value by c. Count online query time and polynomial working storage. Constructing the compact basis is preprocessing and is excluded; the existence of a compact basis does not imply an efficient preprocessing algorithm. Keep c explicit and do not infer a numeric exponent from asymptotic notation.
